title: An upward import hidden under if TYPE_CHECKING
rule: core sits below edge, so core may not import edge
why: The dependency is written down in the source, and a reader following it lands in the layer above. It costs nothing at runtime, which is exactly why it is contested: a tool may reasonably hold that architecture governs coupling rather than execution, or that a type-only edge is free. We record who says what instead of insisting.
